title: Minimal WorkIQ Gatekeeper
goal: Reuse Cloudflare OS native MCP machinery with the smallest WorkIQ-specific adapter and one routing skill
resourceGranularity: Private delegated WorkIQ service connection with named-tool grants; no document-level confinement claim
generatedMethods: Reuse schema-generated named tool methods rather than hand-authoring workload interfaces

executionScope.firstSlice: Complete discovered MCP catalog, including all reads, downloads, mutations, actions, functions and Copilot delegation
executionScope.ask: Conservatively approval-gated unless enforceable upstream read-only behavior is established; not per-step approval inside Copilot
executionScope.directMutations: Fully implemented through native exact-payload approval and durable application

invariants: Existing production Graph functionality and tenant grants remain unchanged
No Pi token-cache, Graph-token, shared bearer, app-only or administrator-token fallback
Any potentially side-effecting dispatch waits for approved application; no annotation-only read classification for ask
Skills and fileUrls do not enforce document confinement
No blind replay after an ambiguous remote call
No synthetic WorkIQ performance test without contractual clearance
No resets or edits to unrelated submodule scratch or root AGENTS.md
compatibilityBlockers: Live hosted registration/credentials/consent/policy not configured or verified; separate approval required
Committed exact submodule pin plus explicit clean-applicable WorkIQ native patch; no implicit dirty-submodule dependency
Native buffered transport remains 1 MiB, not the full remote 4 MB raw file allowance
